candidates.hypothesis: An impulse breakdown followed by a shallow retracement and renewed downside momentum can capture continuation in an established bear regime.
candidates.marketMechanism: Counter-trend liquidity is absorbed during a bounded retracement before dominant supply re-accelerates.
candidates.expectedRegime: BEAR on 15m, 1h and 4h with mature trend age
candidates.entryLogic: Closed impulse and retracement candles only; bearish re-acceleration is confirmed on the signal candle and entered at the next open.
candidates.invalidationLogic: A closed reclaim above the retracement value zone invalidates the continuation thesis.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: The impulse is capitulation and the retracement becomes a reversal.

candidates.hypothesis: A stricter downside impulse and lower-volume shallow retracement can isolate continuation after a bear-state transition.
candidates.marketMechanism: A fresh lower low establishes supply control, while a low-energy retest offers a less extended execution point.
candidates.entryLogic: Closed lower-low impulse, retracement not exceeding the frozen ATR band, then a closed bearish re-acceleration candle; next-open execution.
candidates.invalidationLogic: A closed candle reclaims the impulse midpoint or higher-timeframe bear alignment is absent.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: The apparent continuation is a terminal flush followed by mean reversion.

candidates.hypothesis: A compressed range that confirms a downside break and its first controlled retest can create a separate range-to-bear edge.
candidates.marketMechanism: Former range support becomes overhead supply after trapped longs test the broken floor.
candidates.entryLogic: Closed range floor, confirmed close below it, bounded first retest and bearish signal close; entry is the next open.
candidates.invalidationLogic: A closed reclaim of the range floor invalidates the breakdown.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: The range break is absorbed and rotates back into the range.

candidates.hypothesis: A longer range and stronger participation requirement may distinguish a true downside state change from ordinary range noise.
candidates.marketMechanism: Multi-bar compression stores liquidity around a floor; a high-participation break and failed retest release it lower.
candidates.entryLogic: Closed 30-bar floor break, volume-confirmed retest rejection and next-open execution.
candidates.invalidationLogic: The broken floor is reclaimed on a closed candle.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: A news-driven break lacks follow-through and returns inside the range.

candidates.hypothesis: A one-bar sweep above a local high that closes back below the level and displaces lower can monetize trapped breakout buyers.
candidates.marketMechanism: Buy-side liquidity is taken above a local high, then supply reasserts itself without requiring the primary two-close failure pattern.
candidates.entryLogic: Closed local-high sweep, close back below the level and bearish displacement on the signal candle; next-open entry.
candidates.invalidationLogic: A closed reclaim above the swept high invalidates the sweep.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: The sweep is genuine breakout acceptance rather than rejection.

candidates.hypothesis: A wider local liquidity sweep followed by a close below the level and negative momentum can provide a robust rejection setup.
candidates.marketMechanism: A deeper wick removes resting buy stops before the close reveals failed acceptance and directional supply.
candidates.expectedRegime: RANGE or BULL exhaustion with non-bullish breadth
candidates.entryLogic: Closed wick sweep exceeds the local high by a fixed ATR band, closes below the level, and has bearish momentum; next-open execution.
candidates.invalidationLogic: A closed acceptance above the swept level.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: A volatile breakout continues after taking liquidity.

candidates.hypothesis: Synchronous BTC, ETH and breadth deterioration can identify cross-market downside cascades before a short signal becomes stale.
candidates.marketMechanism: Broad risk reduction reinforces local downside momentum and reduces the probability that a symbol-specific move mean reverts.
candidates.expectedRegime: BTC BEAR, ETH BEAR and breadth <= 35%
candidates.entryLogic: Closed signal candle only: cross-market bear agreement, negative local acceleration, and participation confirmation; next-open entry.
candidates.invalidationLogic: Benchmark agreement breaks or the local signal closes back above its recent value area.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: Cross-market shock is already exhausted when local execution occurs.

candidates.hypothesis: A stricter synchronous cascade with a fresh local lower low can isolate high-conviction cross-market liquidation pressure.
candidates.marketMechanism: Simultaneous benchmark and breadth weakness supplies independent confirmation for a local breakdown.
candidates.entryLogic: Closed lower-low signal candle, strong negative acceleration and synchronized benchmark/breadth bear state; next-open execution.
candidates.invalidationLogic: The local lower low is reclaimed on a closed candle or benchmark agreement disappears.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: The cascade is a short-lived liquidation wick followed by a broad relief rally.

selectionPolicy: Finite preregistration; results cannot alter the registry.
